542097.Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have a green Tamer, [Draw 1] (Draw 1 card from your deck).

542098.Description:
[[Digivolve] Lv.3 w/[Terriermon]/[Lopmon] in name: Cost 2]
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Delete 1 level 3 or lower Digimon. If this effect deleted one of your Digimon, you may play 1 level 3 Digimon card with [Terriermon] or [Lopmon] in its name from your trash without paying the cost.
542098.Inherited Effect: [All Turns] While this Digimon is suspended, it gets +1000 DP.

542101.Description:
[[Digivolve] [Antylamon]: Cost 3]
[Alliance]
[When Digivolving] You may delete 1 level 4 or lower Digimon. Then, you may play 1 level 4 or lower green or purple Digimon card from your hand or trash without paying the cost.

542102.Description:
[Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.
[Main] By placing this Tamer and 1 [Gargomon] and 1 [Rapidmon] from your trash in any order as one of your [Terriermon]'s bottom digivolution cards, that Digimon may digivolve into [MegaGargomon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 4, ignoring its digivolution requirements. If this effect digivolved, that Digimon gains [Rush] for the turn.
542102.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.

542103.Description:
[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 green Digimon card and 1 such Tamer card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.
[Main] [Delay]
• You may play 1 [Terriermon]/[Lopmon] from your hand without paying the cost.
542103.Security Effect: [Security] Suspend 2 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, place this card in the battle area.

542104.Description: [Main] Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, return 1 of their suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck. 1 of their Digimon can't unsuspend until the end of their turn.

542357.Description:
[On Play] You may hatch 1 Digi-Egg card to an empty space in your breeding area.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon would digivolve into a Digimon with [Gargomon] or [Rapidmon] in its name, you may suspend this Tamer to reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
542357.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.

542358.Description:
[Start of Your Turn] If you have 2 memory or less, set your memory to 3.
[Your Turn] When you attack with a Digimon with [Gargomon] or [Rapidmon] in its name, you may suspend this Tamer to suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
542358.Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying its memory cost.

542359.Description:
The name of this card/Digimon is also treated as [Terriermon].
[Your Turn] When an effect suspends this Digimon, 1 of your Digimon gets +4000 DP for the turn.
542359.Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] When [Alliance] suspends one of your Digimon, this Digimon may digivolve into a 2-color green Digimon card in your hand for the cost. When this Digimon would digivolve by this effect, reduce the cost by 2.

542360.Description: [Main] Trash the top card of your security stack. Then, gain 2 memory.

542361.Description: [Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 3000 DP or less. If an opponent's Digimon wasn't deleted by this effect, [Draw 2]. (Draw 2 cards from your deck.)

542362.Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When an effect suspends one of your Digimon, [Draw 1]. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)

542363.Description:
[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 black Digimon card with a play cost of 4 or less among them without paying its memory cost. Trash the remaining cards. Then, place this card in your battle area.
[Main] [Delay] (Trash this card in your battle area to activate the effect below. You can't activate this effect the turn this card enters play.)
• Gain 2 memory.
542363.Security Effect: [Security] Place this card in its owner's battle area.
